no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color in an arbitrary Tailwind value. Add it to tailwind.config.ts's color tokens (or components/ui/ if it's a design-system primitive) instead of hardcoding it per-component — this is exactly the drift that made the pre-rebuild design system inconsistent.
Arbitrary shadow value. Use one of the shadow-* tokens defined in tailwind.config.ts (shadow-card, shadow-gold, ...) instead of a one-off rgba() shadow — add a new token there if none fit.
